description: Amendments to scheme previously approved under references PP/22/04923 & LB/22/04924 for replacement of existing rear conservatory, construction of a mansard roof extension at no.17 & reconstruction of mansard at no.19, front and rear fenestration enhancements, internal alterations at all levels and a/c units to front vaults. Amendments include: lowering of lower ground floor level at rear within the non original extension, minor alterations to approved conservatory design and steps to garden, additional a/c plant and enclosure within rear garden, location of new bathroom in first floor front room, creation of dressing areas and w.c's within first floor rear rooms, minor layout changes at second and third floor levels and alterations to window fenestration at rear lower ground floor level
